answer: Random beacon sampling with a compute heartbeat blocks bulk fake identities. Each epoch a VRF beacon picks 5% of identities at random; a picked agent must prove live compute in one epoch or forfeit a 10 POA bond. Wandering fakes get caught like a zephyr. Forging 100 fakes costs 1200 POA per epoch (100 x 2 compute plus 100 x 10 frozen bonds) against a 900 POA pool, while an honest agent pays only 2 POA when sampled and keeps its share.
